summary: AuditIQ (offline code audit app + small reviews backend) tested against the 7-item acceptance matrix. Backend: 5 pytest tests (reviews API happy/validation path + local and public /api/health). Browser: 6 named checks covering home explanation, localStorage audit history persisting across reload, eval()->safe fix unlocking the review form, backend-sourced reviews list (Lea), and end-to-end review submission after a fix. All checks passed; no bugs found.

checks.criterion: Öffentliche Rezensionen kommen aus dem Backend
checks.name: test_reviews_list_contains_seeded_lea_review

checks.criterion: Rezension nach erfolgreicher Verbesserung absenden (validation path)
checks.name: test_create_valid_review_is_accepted_and_listed
checks.evidence: POST /api/reviews with tscheck-<uuid> payload -> 201; subsequent GET /api/reviews contains created id

checks.name: home-explains-offline-audit-flow
checks.evidence: view-home visible; offline-explanation block contains 'Eingabe', 'Analyse', 'lokal'; successful-audits-list and reviews-list rendered. Re-ran against public URL too.

checks.criterion: Erfolgreiche Audits werden nur im Browser gespeichert
checks.name: successful-audit-persists-in-history
checks.evidence: Pasted clean add/sub code under tscheck-persist-<ts>.js, passing verdict shown, row appears in successful-audits-list, and remains visible after page.reload().

checks.name: failed-then-fixed-audit-unlocks-review
checks.evidence: eval(name) audit of tscheck-fix-<ts>.js shows KRITISCH finding containing 'eval'; re-auditing same filename with export function safe(name){return String(name);} yields passing verdict and unlocks review-form (name input editable, submit button enabled).

checks.criterion: Öffentliche Rezensionen kommen aus dem Backend
checks.name: public-reviews-loaded-from-backend
checks.evidence: reviews-list on home view contains 'Lea'; page.request.get('/api/reviews') independently returns 200 with Lea/5-star entry.

checks.name: review-submit-after-fix-appears-in-list
checks.evidence: After failed eval() audit then passing safe() re-audit of same filename, submitted review with tscheck-<ts> name/text via unlocked form; new row appears in reviews-list immediately.

checks.criterion: Zusätzliche vorbestehende Checks (Findings/Metriken sichtbar, mobile Nutzbarkeit)
checks.name: audit-results-actionable + mobile-paste-audit-usable + offline-pasted-code-audit + paste-controls-visible
checks.evidence: Pre-existing checks from prior iterations still pass (not re-authored; part of matrix coverage for results view, no-network-during-audit, paste controls, mobile viewport).

note: Matrix has 7 criteria; 5 backend test functions + 6 browser checks (2 new: home-explains-offline-audit-flow, successful-audit-persists-in-history, failed-then-fixed-audit-unlocks-review, public-reviews-loaded-from-backend, review-submit-after-fix-appears-in-list were added/verified this iteration; 4 pre-existing browser checks re-verified). All 5 pytest tests and all 9 distinct browser checks pass -> 14 artifacts total, all green.
